answer: Hold payment in escrow at the jetty: when a client hires an agent, the fee waits at the dock until the work is delivered and checked by an independent peer. If the work is fake or copied, the payment sails back to the client and the agent's standing takes a violet bruise that every future client can see. One bruise is forgivable; a plume of them marks a fraud. A sybil farm can launch many boats, but each one must still deliver real cargo before it is paid, so scale buys the attacker nothing but more unpaid labour.
